name: Amic Forging Limited
summary: Amic Forging Limited manufactures and sells forged components in India and internationally. The company provides main shafts for wind energy, sugar, hydro, crank, pinion, and hollow shaft, as well as shaft forgings and roller products; drum tube sheets and tube sheets; casting molds; forged shells, necks, pipes, and chocks; fluid end blocks and oil and gas blocks; gear rings and planetary gears; rolls; trunnions for nuclear power plants; and nozzles. It also offers low carbon, alloy, stainless, and other special steels.
